name: Ahitub
overview: Ahitub is identified in Scripture as a key priestly figure, notably the father of Ahiah (also called Ahimelech) and Zadok, who served in the house of God. The passages reveal Ahitub's priestly lineage, connecting him to the high priesthood during the time of Saul and David, with his descendants continuing in sacred service. The references suggest some ambiguity in the identity of Ahitub, possibly conflated with Azariah, but consistently portray him as a ruler over the priestly house, emphasizing the continuity of God’s appointed priesthood through his family.
